parameters.content:
## Social media evaluation
Write the brief, audience, constraints and Approved facts: section in User_Input. Review each post yourself: write Human_Feedback, then set Status to PASS or FAIL. Jev returns one binary choice; the separate LLM critique is an independent opinion.

Attach Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <OpenRouter API key>) to each HTTP node. Save baseline and revised experiments in separate workbook copies. Keep the same Test_ID and brief. A failed API call is never a quality FAIL.

Generation exports six columns for Evaluation Log. Judge results export seven columns for the separate Judge tab. The combined workflow also has Download Posts CSV for human review; review those posts before opening the judge results. See docs/walkthrough.md.
